dog.description_text:
Dolly Pugton is a 6-month-old chug who weighs around 13 lbs and has apparently decided personal space is wildly overrated. Her foster says she’s the cuddliest dog she’s ever met, and Dolly takes that reputation very seriously.

She loves meeting people, does well with other dogs, and is already good on leash. More than anything, though, she wants to be with her person. Dolly is very attached and doesn’t love being left alone, so she’ll do best with someone who’s excited about having a tiny sidekick involved in a lot of their day.

She’s affectionate, social, and extremely committed to being close to you at all times, preferably touching.

Approved adopters interested in Dolly Pugton can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not approved yet, apply today at hbrdogs.com.
